skill.summary: Get generated video clips ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your text prompts or clips (MP4, MOV, WebM, JPG, up to 500MB), say somethin...

latestVersion.changelog:
Generation Maker 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generate 1080p MP4 video clips from text prompts or uploaded media, no manual editing needed.
- Simple setup: automatic API connection, anonymous token handling, and seamless session management.
- Supports quick uploads (MP4, MOV, WebM, JPG, up to 500MB) and AI-driven video generation for content creators and marketers.
- Exports use a cloud GPU pipeline, with status updates, preview summaries, and easy downloading.
- Includes robust error handling for expired tokens, credits, file limits, and cloud-side issues.
- Optimized for fast workflows: upload, prompt, generate, and download — usually in 1–2 minutes per 30s video.
